clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Muren Stormpike awaits warriors sent from Kharanos for formal training. Granis Swiftaxe sends recruits who have proved their mettle in Dun Morogh to the city's Military Ward.

Granis Swiftaxe sends promising warriors from Kharanos to Ironforge after they face local threats in Dun Morogh. He knows rough skirmishes can teach only so much. In the Military Ward, senior fighters oversee formal training for those bound for battle.

At the Hall of Arms, you meet Muren Stormpike, a veteran of a storied dwarven clan. He wants proof that his new charges can endure real combat, not tavern tales. Reporting to him opens the way to learn defensive arts, control an enemy's aggression, and earn iron arms for the front line.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, warrior! You show a lot of promise, but you still need to learn some tricks and Muren Stormpike is just the dwarf to teach you.
You can find Muren at the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward of Ironforge. Talk to him when you're ready to learn what it is to be a warrior.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend. I heard the warriors of Dun Morogh bouncing your name around. I hope you haven't spent all your time in the breweries!
